title: All The Essentials
description: All your performance essentials in one simple modpack!
body:
# All the performance you'll ever need in one simple modpack!
_"If performance mods in Minecraft are your power, what are you without them?"_ — Socrates, probably.

This modpack attempts to keep stuff as vanilla as possible, so no new features have been added.

Some of the mods included are:
- Sodium,
- Lithium,
- Entity Culling,
- FerriteCore,
- GPUBooster,
- ImmediatelyFast,
- and more!

I designed this modpack (well, I didn't make any of these mods) so that it runs even on the oldest hardware.

If you want to squeeze even more performance out of this, I'd suggest adding JVM flags, such as these (results may vary, ZGC uses more resources on older hardware):

```
-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+UseNUMA -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:+UseFastUnorderedTimeStamps
```

If you want to create your own flags, follow [this guide](https://github.com/brucethemoose/Minecraft-Performance-Flags-Benchmarks).

For very low-end devices, allocate 3-5 GB of memory. For better devices, 6+ GB. Don't over-do it, though, as it can actually cause bigger stutters! 8 GB is my personal sweet spot, so I would go with that.

![Normal terrain generation showcasing FPS count on a VM with 6GB of memory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/m4tbjJcC/images/ebfdeabd3a7d43c639026d52c76a1f27543dde05.png)

For high-end devices, you can go as far as **PATH TRACING**. (I wouldn't try this on an old computer, neither should you. 😵)

![Noble shaders with path tracing enabled on high-end hardware](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/m4tbjJcC/images/be4b0dbef09a6dfdf5887cfb57d8bac75bfbb05b.png)

## Can I play on large servers with this?

As long as you don't add any other mods you suspect of breaking the rules on whatever servers you play on, yes, you absolutely can. (Do your research!)

## There are already thousands of modpacks like this, why bother?

It's mostly just a passion project I made in my free time, I will update this as each Minecraft update comes. It's mainly for my friends who don't know how to install mods manually. I just decided to share this thing with you if you want a ready to go package.

**I did not create any of the mods or files in this pack, and I claim no ownership over them.**

*If there are any things you want to tell me, just DM me on Discord @dabar.gaming*

### TLDR: A simple modpack that makes Minecraft actually run on ancient PCs.
